about: Owners can request a map of a registered land plot, unit, villa or building.
note: Requirements read from the official Dubai Land Department service page on the checked date. The sign-in forms do not publish their field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Property map request. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

documents: Letter from the owner, or from the company if a representative applies and the owner is not present
fees: AED 250 for an apartment or villa map
AED 225 for a land map unified with Dubai Municipality
AED 100 for a plot outside Dubai Municipality
AED 10 knowledge fee and AED 10 innovation fee per drawing
timing: Up to 24 hours when the land map is shared with Dubai Municipality
